youtube_description:
How To pair LG Soundbar Wireless Subwoofer
You need the remote control and some form of pin or tooth pick. This takes roughly 1 minute to complete.

Method 1
1. Reduce the volume to zero/minimum
2. Press and hold the mute button for 5 seconds
 The soundbar will display W RESET
3. Locate the pairing button at the back of your subwoofer unit. Press and hold it for 5 seconds
4. Unplug both the soundbar and sub-woofer unit from the socket
5. Plug then in and the soundbar and wireless subwoofer will pair automatically.

 Method 2
1. Press and hold simultaneously for 5 seconds the stop button on the soundbar unit as well as the remote controls mute button.
2.The soundbar will display REMATE
3. Locate the pairing button at the back of your subwoofer unit. Press and hold it for 5 seconds
4. Unplug both the soundbar and sub-woofer unit ftom the socket
5. Plug then in and the soundbar and wireless subwoofer will pair automatically.
